name: Ascend Medical LLC
old_description: Ascend Medical was founded in 2014 with a goal to help the Treasure Valley have access to more orthopedic, sport bracing, and post op recovery resources. We are have expanded our company to work alongside physicians in Idaho and Utah.
about:
Ascend Medical LLC was founded in 2014 in Boise, Idaho, with the goal of expanding access to orthopedic bracing, sports bracing, and post-operative recovery resources for the Treasure Valley region. The company does not publicly name its founders or ownership structure.

The firm supplies orthopedic bracing, sport bracing, post-operative recovery products, wound-care items, and biologics to patients and physicians across Idaho and Utah. It operates a facility on West Emerald Street in Boise and collaborates directly with healthcare providers, including Veterans Affairs communities, to deliver products and patient-focused services. Headcount, facility size, and order volumes are not disclosed.

Ascend Medical serves patients, orthopedic and sports-medicine physicians, and VA healthcare networks in Idaho and Utah. Its product lines address orthopedics, sports injuries, post-surgical recovery, wound management, and biologic therapies.

The company states its founding mission was to fill a gap in local access to advanced recovery products, and it emphasizes that patient care remains its top priority.
